title: Warm French Semolina Pudding
description: A comforting dessert made with semolina, warm milk, and a hint of jammy flavor.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine semolina, warm milk, and salt. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture comes to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring constantly, for 5-7 minutes or until the semolina is cooked and the mixture has thickened.
Remove from heat and stir in softened butter and granulated sugar until well combined.
Pour the pudding mixture into 4-6 individual serving cups.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until the puddings are set and lightly golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Serve warm, garnished with optional jammy doughnut or eclair pastry pieces.
